verdicts.reason: For changes needing real-daemon integration coverage, ci.yml:38 runs only cargo test while real_engine.rs:371,568,702 marks all three integration tests ignored, so CI does not exercise them; escaped regressions were not measured.

When installation of au to the prefix fails on a legacy home without 2BRAIN_HOME, install.sh:74-77 creates ~/.2brain and repo.rs:911-920 then selects that empty state root instead of ~/.arsumbris; incidence was not measured.

At reviewed revision c5afba6, after an unclean daemon exit and PID reuse daemon.rs:95-109 checks only whether the recorded PID exists and lines 477-509 signal it without verifying ownership; incidence was not measured.

For a YAML literal scalar containing an indented example type: au.engine.repo::au-engine, identity_migration.rs:40-56,151-186 treats the example as a claim and splices user-authored text during migration; incidence was not measured.

For quoted or flow-list legacy claims, identity_migration.rs:185-186,204-210 does not match the token, its line 394 explicitly leaves a flow-list unchanged, and migrate.rs:294-297 can report AlreadyMigrated; incidence was not measured.

For a non-Git batch whose later edit fails, serve.rs:11402-11403,11423-11443 applies operations sequentially while lines 4952 and 5204 exclude non-Git members from compensation and preimage parking, leaving earlier writes despite rejection; incidence was not measured.

When a served member contains a symlink to an outside UTF-8 file, wire.rs:819-839 joins the caller's relative path and serve.rs:12817-12821,13488-13503 reads it without a member-boundary or symlink check, exposing its contents; incidence was not measured.

If a target is unreadable or invalid UTF-8 after an uncertain delete, serve.rs:13489,13498 returns null and lib.rs:2793-2795 treats that null as proof of deletion, producing a false applied outcome; incidence was not measured.

If restoration of a parked ignored-file preimage fails, serve.rs:5047-5057 records the failure but lines 5020-5022 still remove the marker and preimages, while startup also sweeps them at 5539-5544; incidence was not measured.

If a non-Git member's overwrite fails after truncation, mutate.rs:148-149 reports a rejection and serve.rs:5201-5205 parks preimages only for Git members, leaving no restoration copy; incidence was not measured.

When both identity directories exist with a legacy saga marker, identity.rs:20-23,44-52 and serve.rs:5335-5338,5398-5407 make both migration checks point at .2brain, and startup recovery at 5538-5544 also misses the legacy marker; incidence was not measured.

For a member nested in a Git worktree, serve.rs:9729-9744,9771-9799 passes root-relative diff-tree paths to status and history run with git -C at the member root, so dirty or changed paths can be reported clean; incidence was not measured.

At reviewed revision c5afba6, disposable-fixture.sh:19-22,51-53 searches only a fresh HOME's .arsumbris socket directory whereas repo.rs:911-920 chooses .2brain; inherited 2BRAIN_HOME aside, the fixture cannot discover its daemon.

When a client floods version-rejected pings and stops reading stdout, bounded_stdio.rs:173-187 sends inside the receive loop without the timed permit acquisition, while lines 112-116 return permits even for those sends, allowing an indefinitely blocked full channel; incidence was not measured.
If the engine accepts but never answers a rename-type preflight, lib.rs:1665-1674 holds the only mutation permit across an untimed read, preventing subsequent mutations; incidence was not measured.

For a permitted rename in member A with a backlink in editable but ungranted B, lib.rs:1927-1933 sends no member allowlist and serve.rs:4004-4013,6364-6392 gathers and rewrites B while checking only editability; engine test mutate.rs:4935-4997 demonstrates the cross-member cascade.

With no optional limit or summary, lib.rs:2424-2448 forwards an unbounded candidates scan, and docs/research/payload-modes.md:43-44 records a 3.1 MB both-mode production answer; the API has no type filter.

If an uncertain mutation is still executing or another writer changes its target, lib.rs:2783-2807 infers historical outcome from current bytes and can re-arm a retry on the newer hash even though the original may later land; incidence was not measured.

With --payload structured, lib.rs:4138-4139 supplies no text block but served_hash at 4099-4106 reads only a text block, so tb_content at 1184-1186 never records the read required by later mutations; incidence was not measured.

For content longer than max_chars, lib.rs:4312-4320 returns next_offset after always taking the first characters, but ContentArguments at 569-581 has no offset input and the full engine frame is read first; incidence was not measured.

When an allowed editable member contains a nested editable but ungranted member, lib.rs:2878-2890 checks only the supplied repo, wire.rs:787-813 joins the nested path, and mutate.rs:82-85 routes it to the deeper owner without that allowlist; incidence was not measured.

If intent-marker removal fails after successful commits, serve.rs:5020-5022 ignores it and returns the outcome, while lines 5538-5543,5582-5585 revert the recorded commits during the next recovery; incidence was not measured.

For --all with an unreadable or malformed registry, migrate.rs:121-142 converts read or parse failures to an empty registry and can fall back to the current directory instead of reporting incomplete coverage; incidence was not measured.

For the supported unqualified custom claim au.engine.custom, engine_schema.rs:129-144 preserves its name but lines 257-279 emit a stale-spelling hint and suggested fix, whereas identity_migration.rs:273-282 explicitly leaves it unchanged; incidence was not measured.

For legacy claims in a type definition, parse.rs:247-256 canonicalizes without collecting legacy hints, while engine_schema.rs:287-305 only generates those hints for instances, making the advertised migration diagnostic incomplete; incidence was not measured.

After the last document containing an exact spelling is removed, search.rs:913-933 retains its dictionary ID with no postings and lines 1255-1261 return that ID before trying a live plural or singular; incidence was not measured.

For every query term absent from the exact dictionary, search.rs:1255-1261 calls word_forms, whose lines 1566-1587 allocate candidate strings and perform multiple probes contrary to CODING_STANDARDS.md:29-30; performance impact was not measured.

When two batch operations produce different hashes for one path, serve.rs:11474-11481 retains both intermediate hashes and lines 11497-11499 require the single catalog entry to equal both, permanently reporting reflected=false; incidence was not measured.

For a merge commit, serve.rs:9760-9775 accepts multiple parents and defaults safe to true while gitwriter.rs:681-709 documents and uses a diff-tree form that reports no merge paths, yielding an empty safe preview; incidence was not measured.

On a clean checkout with the documented engine override, client-matrix.sh:12,18-20 builds with Cargo but keeps looking under target/debug whereas .cargo/config.toml:7-12 directs output to the shared .cargo-target; incidence was not measured.

On a clean checkout without a CARGO_TARGET_DIR override, scripts/install.sh:25,35-38 installs from tb-mcp-rs/target although .cargo/config.toml:7-12 uses the shared target and c5afba6 does not track that target symlink.

At reviewed revision c5afba6, if a fixture runner is killed without its EXIT trap while the daemon and fixture directory survive, disposable-fixture.sh:77-86 skips the daemon because its directory still exists; incidence was not measured.

At reviewed revision c5afba6, running strict-client.py outside /root/2brain without AU_ENGINE_BIN still invokes the absolute /root/2brain engine path at lines 30 and 53-54, so a different checkout cannot use its own engine by default; incidence was not measured.

For a custom starter named sample with an unrelated sample-extra workspace member, cli.rs:462-481 globally replaces the prefix in both member scalars and overwrites the generated manifest, corrupting the latter name; incidence was not measured.

When the complete engine instances response exceeds 16 MiB, lib.rs:2411-2419 requests all instances before applying even limit=1 and transport.rs:27-28,229-237 rejects the frame; the threshold incidence was not measured.

During concurrent file-addressed reads, lib.rs:3188-3206 retains a read-slot permit while self.read acquires another at line 3282, so calls can hit the eight-permit capacity before eight operations are in flight; incidence was not measured.

With --tools full --payload text, lib.rs:3401-3408 retains output schemas but lines 4128-4139 omit structured content, and docs/research/payload-modes.md:125-137 records an actual schema-validating client rejection.

For the synthetic search fixture, real_engine.rs:229-234 creates bodyless notes/b.md and fixture_cases at 265-335 never captures tb_search, yet tb_search.json:17-20 asserts that note matched and search.rs:1509-1525 excludes bodyless notes.

When 2BRAIN_HOME is inherited, real_engine.rs:381-392 overrides HOME but not that variable, repo.rs:911-913 chooses the external state root, and the test searches only its temporary home; incidence was not measured.

For inline topic arrays or fenced wikilink text, census.py:31-32,61-68 misses or overcounts links but lines 94-97 and 175-178 present the regex totals as outbound link counts; incidence was not measured.
